title: Release stuck state lock
description: Manually release a Terraform state lock that was not properly cleared — typically needed when a previous apply was interrupted, leaving the state locked and blocking further operations.

breakdown.meaning: Manually remove a stuck state lock
The lock ID shown in the error message when the state is locked

flags.description: Skip the interactive confirmation prompt

output:
Do you really want to force-unlock?
  Terraform will remove the lock on the remote state.
  This will allow local Terraform commands to modify this state, even though it
  may be still be in use. Only 'yes' will be accepted to confirm.

  Enter a value: yes

Terraform state has been successfully unlocked!
tip: Only run force-unlock after confirming no other Terraform process is actively running against this state — running it while an apply is in progress can corrupt the state file. The LOCK_ID is printed in the error message when you hit a locked state.

tip: Run terraform plan -refresh-only first to see what has drifted before applying. The legacy terraform refresh command is deprecated since 0.15.4 — -refresh-only gives you review/approval control that the old command lacked.
